title: Explainer: how retries work
question: Which explanation fits the retry explainer?

options.label: Diagram first
options.description: A single flow diagram, then a paragraph per step. Best for readers who think visually.

options.label: Worked example
options.description: Follow one failed charge through every retry with real timestamps.

options.label: Question by question
options.description: Answer the five questions support hears most, in the order they get asked.

content:
New support staff ask how a failed charge is retried. The explainer should leave them able to tell a customer what happens next and when.

This is the path the explainer has to cover, whichever option you pick.
